Big Thump.reason: Verified non-Canadian artist. The Northern Dial Big Thump credit resolves to J Toney: J Toney's official EPK states that Jeffery was born and raised in Oakland, California and began making music under the moniker 'Big Thump.' DLabrie's Bandcamp release independently credits 'Big Thump (J Toney)' on the East Bay Legends remix, confirming the alias/catalogue match. This is therefore a U.S. artist rather than a Canadian artist-library profile.
